# Vendored Boxes.py (runtime)

Payas STEM CAD needs the Boxes.py tree plus `products/`. Vercel has no `C:\Project\boxes-master`, so a slim copy lives here: Python package, Payas products, `components.json`. Drawings/output are not included.

Locally `boxes_adapter` still prefers `BOXES_PATH` or `C:\Project\boxes-master` when present.
